summary: GMR Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026 disclosing that subsidiary Global Medical Response, Inc. obtained binding lender commitments to reprice its existing first lien term loan, cutting the SOFR margin from +3.25% to +2.75% (about 50 basis points), and to voluntarily prepay roughly $200 million of the outstanding balance. Expected annual cash interest savings approximate $28 million; closing targeted on or about September 17, 2026, subject to definitive documentation and customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or equity stake is stated; watch execution risk and deleveraging follow-through.
